decisions.reason: As a peripheral accelerator program rather than a machinery offering, it is more likely to fall below aspiration levels and be cut so resources can be redirected to core equipment and nearer-term development projects.

The bio-based binder is a sustainability-oriented innovation but sits outside the firm's main machinery business, so under bounded rationality and likely uncertain early results management would be somewhat more likely to discontinue it than carry it forward.

The infectious waste decontamination plant was prominently launched on the home page with a clear partner-based value proposition, which fits a machinery firm's core capabilities and justifies continued support while market results are still forming.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant is strongly aligned with the firm's equipment business and was highlighted as a latest product on the home page, so management would likely retain it unless early performance were clearly far below aspiration.
